svg.aria-label: Quire Analyze turns Contract IR clauses into an analysis request, lowers it to an SMT-LIB query over Booleans, runs a pinned solver (Z3 or cvc5) and classifies the reply. The answer is satisfied, refuted with a verified witness model, unknown, timeout, unsupported or tool-error.
